answer: A workable defense is trust propagation via short random walks, SybilRank style. Walks start from trusted seed agents; identities are scored by landing frequency, so the ember of trust travels only along real connections. An attacker's fakes form a dense but isolated orchard, tied to the honest graph by few attack edges, so seed walks rarely enter and sybils score near zero. Raising a score means buying genuine attestations for more entry edges, making each sybil costly. The terrace of trust then reflects real embedding. Limits: seeds can be captured, and honest newcomers start at zero.
